title: Income Tax Accounting - ASC 740 Fundamentals
learning_objectives: Understand the asset and liability method for income taxes
Calculate current and deferred tax expense
Identify and account for temporary differences
Understand valuation allowance for deferred tax assets

common_question_types: Calculate deferred tax assets and liabilities
Journal entries for income tax provision

overview.method: Asset and liability method (balance sheet approach)
overview.principle: Recognize tax consequences of events in same period as the events themselves
overview.key_concept: Deferred taxes arise from temporary differences between book basis and tax basis of assets/liabilities

fundamental_equation.total_income_tax_expense: Current Tax Expense (Payable) + Deferred Tax Expense (or - Deferred Tax Benefit)

components.definition: Taxes payable (or refundable) for current year based on taxable income
components.appears_on: Balance sheet as Current Tax Payable (or Receivable)

components.definition: Change in deferred tax assets and liabilities during the year
components.appears_on: Balance sheet as Deferred Tax Assets and Deferred Tax Liabilities

temporary_differences.definition: Differences between book basis and tax basis of assets/liabilities that will reverse in future periods
temporary_differences.create: Deferred tax assets or deferred tax liabilities
temporary_differences.key_principle: Results in taxable or deductible amounts in future years

types.description: Will result in taxable amounts in future when asset recovered or liability settled

examples.book_basis: Asset has higher basis for book purposes
examples.tax_basis: Asset has lower basis for tax purposes
examples.future_impact: When asset recovered, more taxable income than book income
examples.journal_entry_concept: DR Deferred Tax Expense, CR Deferred Tax Liability

examples.scenario: Revenue recognized for book when sale occurs, but tax uses installment method
examples.timing: Book recognizes revenue now, tax recognizes later
examples.future_impact: Future tax payments when cash collected

examples.item: Unrealized gains on investments (AFS securities before OCI)
examples.scenario: Gains recognized in book income but not taxable until realized

types.description: Will result in deductible amounts in future when asset recovered or liability settled

examples.scenario: Book expenses warranty when sold (accrual), tax deducts when paid
examples.tax_basis: No liability for tax (deduct when paid)
examples.future_impact: Future tax deductions when warranty costs paid
examples.journal_entry_concept: DR Deferred Tax Asset, CR Deferred Tax Benefit (reduces expense)

examples.scenario: Book uses allowance method, tax uses direct write-off
examples.timing: Book expense now, tax deduction later

examples.scenario: Book expenses when earned, tax deducts when paid
Tax losses available to offset future taxable income
examples.creates: Deferred tax asset for benefit of future deductions

permanent_differences.definition: Differences between book income and taxable income that will NEVER reverse
permanent_differences.create: NO deferred taxes (only affect current tax expense)
permanent_differences.impact: Causes effective tax rate to differ from statutory rate

examples.note: Pre-TCJA was 50%, post-TCJA varies by type

examples.tax: Partial or full exclusion (50%, 65%, or 100% depending on ownership)

identification_process.question: Will this difference reverse in the future?
identification_process.if_yes: Temporary difference → Creates deferred tax asset or liability
identification_process.if_no: Permanent difference → Affects current tax only, no deferred tax

deferred_tax_liability.meaning: Taxes that will be paid in future when difference reverses

calculation: This is taxable temporary difference (book basis > tax basis)
example.interpretation: In future years, when book depreciation > tax depreciation, will pay $2,500 more in taxes

deferred_tax_asset.when_created: Deductible temporary differences or NOL carryforwards
deferred_tax_asset.meaning: Taxes that will be saved in future when difference reverses

calculation: This is deductible temporary difference (book liability, no tax liability)
example.interpretation: When warranty costs paid in future, will save $10,000 in taxes

permanent_differences: Municipal bond interest (included in book income): $10,000

calculation: Add: Permanent differences that reduce book but not tax:
Fines and penalties: +$5,000 (not deductible for tax)
Subtract: Permanent differences that are in book but not in tax:
Add: Current year taxable temporary difference: $30,000 × 25% = $7,500
Add: Current year deductible temporary difference: $25,000 × 25% = $6,250
Total Income Tax Expense / Pretax Book Income = $126,250 / $500,000 = 25.25%
Close to 25% statutory rate (difference due to permanent items)

journal_entries.description: Record income tax expense and payable
journal_entries.entry:
DR Income Tax Expense $126,250
DR Deferred Tax Asset $6,250
   CR Deferred Tax Liability $7,500
   CR Income Tax Payable $125,000

valuation_allowance.purpose: Reduce deferred tax asset to amount more likely than not (>50%) to be realized
valuation_allowance.when_required: If it is more likely than not that some or all of DTA will NOT be realized
factors_requiring_allowance: Lack of taxable income in carryback periods
Unsettled circumstances that might adversely affect future income
factors_against_allowance: Taxable temporary differences that will reverse in carryforward period

accounting.establish_allowance: DR Income Tax Expense, CR Valuation Allowance (contra-DTA)
accounting.reduce_allowance: DR Valuation Allowance, CR Income Tax Benefit (reduces expense)
accounting.presentation: Deferred Tax Asset - Valuation Allowance = Net Deferred Tax Asset

facts: More likely than not only $60,000 will be realized
example.entry:
DR Income Tax Expense $40,000
   CR Valuation Allowance $40,000
example.balance_sheet: Deferred Tax Asset $100,000 - Valuation Allowance $40,000 = Net $60,000

tax_rate_changes.principle: Deferred tax assets and liabilities measured using enacted tax rate expected to apply when asset realized or liability settled

when_rate_changes.adjustment_required: Remeasure all deferred tax assets and liabilities using new rate
when_rate_changes.recognize_adjustment: In income from continuing operations in period of enactment

example.journal_entry:
DR Income Tax Expense $10,000
   CR Deferred Tax Liability $10,000
example.explanation: Higher future tax rate means larger future tax payment, so increase DTL now

net_operating_losses.definition: Tax loss that can be carried forward to offset future taxable income
net_operating_losses.accounting: Recognize deferred tax asset for tax benefit of NOL carryforward

calculation.dta_from_nol: NOL Carryforward × Expected Tax Rate = Deferred Tax Asset
calculation.valuation_allowance: Required if more likely than not will not realize benefit

facts: Expected to generate profits in next 3 years
journal_entry_year_1: Explanation: Recognize benefit of NOL carryforward
journal_entry_when_used: When NOL used in Year 2 to offset $100,000 of taxable income:
Current tax payable in Year 2: $0 (offset by NOL)

post_tcja_rules.carryback: Generally not allowed (except for certain losses)
post_tcja_rules.limitation: NOL can offset only 80% of taxable income in carryforward years

intraperiod_tax_allocation.principle: Allocate total tax expense to different components of comprehensive income
intraperiod_tax_allocation.method: Tax effect of item calculated separately and reported with that item

systematic_approach: 1. Calculate taxable income: Start with book income, adjust for permanent and temporary differences
2. Calculate current tax expense: Taxable income × rate
3. Calculate ending DTA/DTL balances: Beginning + change from temporary differences
4. Calculate deferred tax expense: Change in DTL - change in DTA

identification_tips.temporary: Ask: Will this reverse? If yes → temporary → creates DTA or DTL
identification_tips.permanent: Ask: Will this reverse? If no → permanent → affects only current tax, no deferred
identification_tips.taxable_temporary: Book basis > Tax basis for assets, or Book liability < Tax liability → DTL
identification_tips.deductible_temporary: Book basis < Tax basis for assets, or Book liability > Tax liability → DTA

common_mistakes: Wrong direction: Adding when should subtract (or vice versa) in taxable income calculation
Forgetting to multiply temporary differences by tax rate to get DTA/DTL
Not considering valuation allowance when DTA realization is uncertain
Using wrong tax rate (use enacted rate expected to apply when difference reverses)

memory_aids.permanent_current_only: P = Permanent affects Present tax only
memory_aids.dtl_formula: Taxable temp diff × Rate = DTL (future Tax Liability)
memory_aids.dta_formula: Deductible temp diff × Rate = DTA (future Tax Asset)

critical_concepts: Income tax expense = Current tax + Deferred tax expense (or - deferred tax benefit)
Temporary differences create deferred tax assets (deductible) or liabilities (taxable)
Permanent differences affect only current tax, no deferred taxes
DTA = Deductible temporary difference × Tax rate (future tax savings)
DTL = Taxable temporary difference × Tax rate (future tax payments)
Valuation allowance reduces DTA if realization not more likely than not
Tax rate changes require remeasurement of DTAs and DTLs
NOL carryforwards create DTA (with valuation allowance if needed)

key_formulas.taxable_income: Book Income ± Permanent Differences ± Temporary Differences
key_formulas.deferred_tax_expense: Increase in DTL - Increase in DTA
